pages.label: Studio: Drawing Foundations
pages.html:
Studio 01 · 12 weeks · Beginner

Drawing Foundations

Twelve weekly studios with live critique. You need paper, a 2B pencil and a window.

Enrol · RM 690See progress

Weeks 1–3 · Line and observation

Contour, blind drawing, measuring by eye.

Weeks 4–6 · Light and form

Value scales, shading, the cast shadow.

Weeks 7–9 · Composition

Thumbnails, cropping, negative space.

Weeks 10–12 · Final study

One sustained still life with critique.

pages.label: FAQ
pages.html:
Home/FAQ

FAQ

I have never drawn. Is that okay?

Drawing Foundations is made for you.

What materials do I need?

A short list is sent after enrolment; most is under RM 120.

Is there a portfolio at the end?

Yes. You'll finish with 6–8 works and a short statement.
